findings.finding: The captured production changes satisfy the migration contract. Both new compare overloads and varargs max/min use the required Comparable<? super T> bound. Compare handles identical references, null ordering, and delegates non-null values to compareTo. The varargs methods safely handle null arrays and all-null input, ignore null entries, and use strict comparison so equal values retain the first entry. The existing two-argument ComparableUtils max/min implementations remain in place. All ObjectUtils compare/max/min signatures remain and delegate to ComparableUtils.
evidence: Code-kb CLI body/context on the completed grade public-project showed ComparableUtils.compare at lines 163-190, max at 263-291, min at 307-335, and ObjectUtils delegates at lines 292-310, 1016-1019, and 1076-1079.

A read-only seed-to-captured diff showed the existing two-argument ComparableUtils max/min methods remain behaviorally unchanged; their delegation target is now the local compare helper. ObjectUtils compatibility bodies are direct delegates.

Code-kb refs on ObjectUtils.max showed the existing ObjectUtilsTest#testMax caller and the new migration-test callers; the captured public grade ran ObjectUtilsTest#testMax and ComparableUtilsTest#testMax.

findings.finding: The added test file covers null ordering in both directions, comparison of values implementing Comparable on a base type, null/empty/all-null varargs, ignored null entries, first-entry tie behavior, the unchanged fixed-arity overload behavior, and ObjectUtils delegation.
